Sparkling wine from the Alps, Ferrari 'Brut' — Trento, Italy

Pick ONE sensory word per dish (buttery, silky, blackened, crisp) and say it with a little more emphasis — that’s usually what tips a guest from “sounds nice” to “I’ll have that.”

Remember“Use one strong word. Say it with confidence. Help them taste it before they try it.”
